scope: One paired baseline start; repaired K-L in both arms, 9000 fitting and scoring trials per condition

prior_attempt.outcome: GPU unit tests passed; conjugate cutoff check failed before fitting; raw archive preserved

configuration.target: Mean effective active parameter error <=0.05; median independent-MC G2 <= true-parameter median +10% absolute magnitude +1
configuration.scoring_note: Three independent simulator seeds on the same observations; fixed training checkpoints, no scoring feedback
configuration.compared_features: Legacy versus improvement 1, both with mode-indexed K-L repair; other improvements off
configuration.precision: fp32 spatial fields, fp64 RT, x64 enabled, default matmul
configuration.cache_note: Same reduced basis cache for all variants; library default unchanged
